_comment: pc/boat-slots: the hero J/22's flat hardware materials (materials.json flat_materials, M_BoatSurface) folded into packs of up to 8, one slot each; the entry is in UV1.x and MI_J22H_<Pack> on M_BoatPacked holds the entries' values (scripts/import_j22_hero.py). The baked groups (J22H_<group>, M_J22HeroSurface), the glass and the mast's aluminium (M_BoatMast) keep their own slots. Append, never reorder. The wood pack also takes the small slots later passes added to the hull (hero ageing, Nov 9 2026: the hatch acrylic, traveler line, decals, telltale yarn and the tack strop's halyard rope), so SM_J22H_Hull stays inside BoatBudget's 6 slots; a new hull material needs a pack entry too.
